articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.snippet: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
articles.snippet: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

articles.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
articles.snippet: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

articles.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
articles.snippet: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.
